preconditions.description: Input dimensions n, m, and K are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= num <= n*m for row in board for num in row)
preconditions.description: Every entry in the board matrix is between -1 and n*m (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cost <= 100000 for row in costs for cost in row)
preconditions.description: Every entry in the cost matrix is between 1 and 100000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: len(board) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in board) and len(costs) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in costs)
preconditions.description: The board and cost matrices are n x m in size.

postconditions.description: Output is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer (minimum cost).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= m for i, j in selected_cells) and all(board[i-1][j-1] != -1 for i, j in selected_cells) and len(set(board[i-1][j-1] for i, j in selected_cells if board[i-1][j-1] > 0)) >= K
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, there exists a connected block of cells (selected_cells) with at least K distinct positive numbers and no -1, where selected_cells is a subset of the board cells.

postconditions.expression: sum(costs[i-1][j-1] for i, j in selected_cells) == int(stdout.strip()) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum total cost of selecting such a connected block, or -1 if no such block exists.

postconditions.expression: not exists_connected_block or (stdout.strip() == '-1' and not exists_connected_block) or (stdout.strip() != '-1' and exists_connected_block)
postconditions.description: Output is -1 if and only if no connected block with at least K distinct positive numbers and no -1 exists (exists_connected_block is a semantic helper).
